name: Bronze panoply
notes: Articulated armor kit authored assembled on a 1.75 m body. Origin at the neck base, +Y up, face toward +Z, kit +X = person left. Parts: helmet, crest, chest, back, shoulderL, shoulderR, gauntletL, gauntletR, shield, spear, cape. Joints cape -1...1 (sway 20 degrees), crest -1...1 (sway 12 degrees), shield 0...1 (raise 0.2 m), spear 0...1 (tilt 77 degrees, push 0.55 m). Greaves omitted.
parts: hammered bronze muscle cuirass with pecs, sternal groove and abs, rolled edges, side rivets and waist seam
back plate with spine groove and scapulae
Corinthian helm with cut face opening, nose bar, inner liner and rolled rims
bronze crest stand and horsehair crest
banded vambraces with wrist flare and elbow cops
red wool cape lofted as a folded strip with hem trim and collar roll
round hoplon with rolled rim, ridges, raised lambda, rivets and arm straps
2.1 m spear with ash shaft, leather grip, iron socket and leaf blade, bronze butt spike
style: Hoplite bronze panoply, hammered bronze with warm tarnish, crimson wool, tan leather, cinematic realism.
summary: Hoplite bronze panoply: hammered muscle cuirass, crested Corinthian helm, red cape, pauldrons, vambraces, hoplon shield and spear.
